name: Shape Guy
storyline: In Shape Guy you play as Eyeball, who has boldly ventured into Shape Guy's dome to defeat him and free the world under his command. But Shape Guy himself is not the only threat in this world… Brave the wild creatures of the Floating Isles, the dark and secretive inhabitants of the Great Dungeon and more in this retro video game!
summary: Shape guy is a platformer rage game created by Gumballs Falling. Inspired by rage games of the 80's/90's, Shape Guy introduces obstacles to overcome, mechanics to help on your journey, and an obscure narrative to follow.
